externalBlockers.statement: SELECT workspace_id, feature_id, item_kind, status, payload, harness_slug, taken_by FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE ( (payload -> 'externalBlockers') @> jsonb_build_array( jsonb_build_object('ref', $1::text, 'status', 'active') ) AND jsonb_path_exists( payload -> 'externalBlockers', '$[*] ? (@.ref == $ref && @.status == "active" && (@.kind == "event" || @.kind == "gate"))', jsonb_build_object('ref', $2::text) ) ) FOR UPDATE

durableParks.statement: SELECT workspace_id, harness_slug, feature_id, item_kind, status AS state, taken_by, payload FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE ( payload ? 'claim_hold_release' AND (payload -> 'claim_hold_release') ->> 'trigger' = $1 AND payload ->> '_claimHold' = 'true' AND NULLIF(payload ->> 'claim_hold_by', '') IS NOT NULL AND (taken_by IS NULL OR btrim(taken_by) = '') ) FOR UPDATE
